Prospect FAQ

Three questions buyers always ask.

How fast do you respond to a new scoping request?
Within twenty-four hours of submission, a named Chartered Engineer on the line. Not a sales account manager, not a call-centre agent. The engineer who would sign the deliverable confirms the discipline fit, asks any clarifying questions, and books a forty-five-minute discovery call. Joint scoping document follows within seventy-two hours of the discovery call. The full engineering proposal with named CEng signature lands within seven calendar days.
Do you sign NDAs before any technical disclosure?
Yes. Mutual NDA on request before the first discovery call if your scoping requires technical disclosure on your side. Our standard mutual NDA template available on request. We also countersign client-provided NDAs without commercial review for standard mutual non-disclosure scope. Specialised provisions (export control, country-specific data residency) reviewed by our legal counsel within two business days.
Can you scope international plants, or India-only?
Twenty-one countries delivered as of 2026. Hyderabad HQ runs the global practice across India, the GCC (UAE, KSA, Qatar), South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Oceania. Houston USA operations entity handles American Gulf Coast brownfield work to NFPA 70E and IEEE 1584. Local-native standards applied per geography: NFPA + IEEE in the US, IEC + IS in India, IEC + GCC standards in the Middle East, AS/NZS in Australia. Multilingual arc flash signage where the regulator requires it.
